categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extent, owners' names and identities, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
